map.计算吸烟花费的金钱和健康成本，看看戒烟能省多少钱: Calculate the money and health cost of smoking, and see how much quitting can save
map.日花费 = 每日支数 ÷ 每包支数 × 每包价格；年花费 = 日花费 × 365: Daily cost = cigarettes per day ÷ cigarettes per pack × price per pack; yearly cost = daily cost × 365; total cost = yearly cost × years
map.总吸烟量 = 每日支数 × 365 × 年数；累计寿命损失 ≈ 总支数 × 11: Total cigarettes = per day × 365 × years; cumulative life lost ≈ total cigarettes × 11 minutes
map.💰 未来戒烟能省多少钱？: 💰 How much can quitting save in the future?
map.从你最后一支烟开始，身体就在不断修复: From your last cigarette, your body keeps repairing itself
map.心率和血压恢复正常，血液循环改善: Heart rate and blood pressure return to normal, circulation improves
map.血液中一氧化碳水平降至正常: Blood carbon monoxide level drops to normal
map.心脏病发作风险开始下降: Heart attack risk begins to fall
map.嗅觉和味觉开始恢复: Smell and taste begin to recover
map.支气管放松，呼吸更顺畅，肺功能提升: Bronchi relax, breathing becomes easier, lung function improves
map.血液循环改善，肺功能提升30%，运动能力增强: Circulation improves, lung function rises 30%, exercise capacity increases
map.咳嗽、气短减少，纤毛恢复，肺部感染减少: Cough and shortness of breath decrease, cilia recover, lung infections decrease
map.中风风险降至非吸烟者水平，口腔癌风险减半: Stroke risk falls to the level of non-smokers, oral cancer risk halves
map.肺癌死亡风险降低50%，多种癌症风险下降: Lung cancer death risk drops 50%, and the risk of several cancers falls
map.冠心病风险与非吸烟者相同: Coronary heart disease risk equals that of non-smokers
map.所有癌症风险大幅降低，预期寿命接近不吸烟者: Overall cancer risk drops substantially; life expectancy approaches that of non-smokers
map.* 基于每吸一支烟平均减少约11分钟寿命估算: * Estimated on about 11 minutes of life lost per cigarette smoked
map.🎁 省下的钱可以做什么？: 🎁 What can you do with the money saved?
map.以戒烟1年节省的费用计算: Calculated on the savings from quitting for 1 year
map.• 设定戒烟日，做好心理准备: • Set a quit date and get mentally prepared
map.• 告诉家人朋友，寻求支持: • Tell family and friends and seek support
map.• 扔掉香烟、打火机、烟灰缸: • Throw away cigarettes, lighters and ashtrays
map.• 了解戒烟的好处和挑战: • Learn about the benefits and challenges of quitting
map.通常持续3-5分钟，深呼吸、喝水、做其他事情转移注意力: usually last 3-5 minutes; take deep breaths, drink water or do something else to distract yourself
map.运动、冥想、听音乐放松: exercise, meditate or listen to music to relax
map.睡前避免咖啡因，建立规律作息: avoid caffeine before bed and establish a regular routine
map.准备健康零食，多喝水: prepare healthy snacks and drink more water
map.适当休息，分段工作: rest appropriately and work in segments
map.尼古丁贴片、口香糖、含片等（遵医嘱）: nicotine patches, gum, lozenges, etc. (follow medical advice)
map.改变吸烟习惯，替代行为: change smoking habits and substitute behaviors
map.• 远离吸烟环境和烟友: • Stay away from smoking environments and smoking friends
map.• 饭后立即离开餐桌，刷牙或散步: • Leave the table right after meals, brush your teeth or take a walk
map.• 压力大时用其他方式放松（运动、冥想）: • Relax in other ways under stress (exercise, meditation)
map.• 记录戒烟日记，提醒自己为什么戒烟: • Keep a quit diary to remind yourself why you quit
map.• 偶尔一支不是失败，立即回到正轨: • One occasional cigarette is not failure; get back on track immediately
map.• 为家人孩子创造无烟环境: • Create a smoke-free environment for family and children
map.• 省钱！省钱！省钱！: • Save money! Save money! Save money!
map.本计算器数据仅供参考，不能替代专业医生的诊断和建议。戒烟方法因人而异，建议在医生: This calculator's data is for reference only and cannot replace a professional doctor's diagnosis and advice. Quit methods vary between individuals; quitting under a doctor's guidance is recommended. If serious discomfort occurs during quitting, seek medical care promptly.
map.估算累计花费：输入单包价格与每日吸烟量，按 365 天/年累加，直观看到 1/5: Estimate cumulative spending: enter the pack price and daily cigarette count and accumulate over 365 days/year to see the cumulative spend over 1/5/10/20 years.
map.戒烟后的「省下金额」：把原本买烟的钱视为可节省开支，按戒烟年限展示复利式增长的总: The "amount saved" after quitting: treat the money previously spent on cigarettes as savable expense and show the compound-style growing total over the quit period as motivation.
map.对比健康隐性成本：除直接烟钱外，吸烟相关疾病的医疗、误工等隐性成本更高，本工具聚: Compare hidden health costs: beyond the direct cigarette money, the hidden costs of smoking-related illness such as medical care and lost work are even higher; this tool focuses on the directly quantifiable money saved.
map.算例：25 元/包、每天 1 包: Example: 25 CNY per pack, 1 pack per day
map.年花费 = 25 × 365 = 9,125 元；5 年 = 45,625 元；: Yearly cost = 25 × 365 = 9,125 CNY; 5 years = 45,625 CNY; 10 years = 91,250 CNY; 20 years = 182,500 CNY. Quitting is equivalent to "saving 9,125 CNY per year".
map.只算烟钱会不会低估危害？: Does counting only cigarette money underestimate the harm?
map.会的。烟草相关肺病、心血管病的医疗与误工成本远超烟钱本身，且健康损失难以用金钱衡: Yes. The medical and lost-work costs of tobacco-related lung and cardiovascular disease far exceed the cigarette money itself, and the health loss is hard to measure in money. This tool only quantifies the directly countable spending savings.
map.戒烟有什么省钱之外的好处？: What benefits does quitting have beyond saving money?
map.嗅觉味觉恢复、心肺功能改善、皮肤与牙齿变好、家人免受二手烟危害，并显著降低多种慢: Smell and taste recover, heart and lung function improve, skin and teeth get better, family is spared secondhand smoke, and the risk of several chronic diseases drops significantly. The earlier you quit, the greater the benefit.
map.戒烟成本计算器。健康指标计算工具，基于权威医学标准，数据本地处理保护隐私。: Quit-Smoking Savings Calculator. A health-metric calculation tool based on authoritative medical standards, with all data processed locally to protect privacy.
